svg.title: Admission
svg.desc: Three 16 by 16 boards of drawers, each holding 16 of 4,096 words. A query star opens the 8 nearest occupied drawers, shaded. At the start the target word's drawer is open. After 4,096 training batches, in both the control arm and the Relation arm, learning has moved the target's drawer outside the opened set, so it is unreachable. Counters: 1,351, then 857, then 551 of 3,847 copy-successor targets reachable. Below, a bar chart of target-admitted rows on the 14,287-row panel against the 4,894 gate.
svg.text: Admission: only words in the opened drawers can be chosen

The same ceiling on the full 14,287-row panel: target-admitted rows
K16-A and K16-R: two objectives, two seeds each (run numbers are listing order). Hatched rows are vacuous. A different sub-panel from the 1,351 of 3,847.
Grid positions and the single target word are illustrative; only the counters and bar values are measured.
